Operations APIs (role operations )
Activate user, list users, resend activation magic link, delete user.
Feedback APIs
Submit feedback, check eligibility ( /api/v1/feedback/eligibility ), record prompt state ( /api/v1/feedback/prompt ). Feedback
kinds: POST_TASK , GENERAL , CANCELLATION , DROP_OFF . Journeys: capacity_upload , reservation_request , app_general .
Categories: suggest_feature , report_problem , general . Prompt states: SHOWN , SUBMITTED , SKIPPED , DISMISSED .

Internal APIs (hidden from schema)
POST /api/v1/internal/salesforce/offtake-sync , /notify-failure , /partner-domain-sync  — caller client_id  must equal
SFDC_SYNC_CALLER_CLIENT_ID .
POST /api/v1/internal/audit/keycloak-event  — Keycloak audit listener ingest.
Cross-cutting behaviour
JWT validation against Keycloak; permissions from scope , realm_access.roles  and resource_access.*.roles  claims.
Middleware blocks users who are PENDING or have not accepted terms (with an allowlist for the endpoints needed to
ﬁnish setup).
Request body limit 15 MB; CSV upload limit 10 MB.
Redis-backed rate limiting per bucket.
